versions.subject: feat: more updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_main_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\whoami.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'whoami.exe'
selection_main_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -all'
        - ' /all'
        - ' /FO CSV'
        - ' -FO CSV'
selection_special:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'whoami'
        - '>'
condition: all of selection_main_* or selection_special
versions.spl: (Image="*\\whoami.exe" OR OriginalFileName="whoami.exe" CommandLine IN ("* -all*", "* /all*", "* /FO CSV*", "* -FO CSV*")) OR (CommandLine="*whoami*" CommandLine="*>*")
